proxy.name: infath-out-gsb-zatca
proxy.description: REST/JSON facade over the DZIT/ZATCA Zakat Certificate SOAP service (5 operations). Converts JSON requests to SOAP, routes via the GSB target server, and returns cleaned, namespace-free JSON responses.

policies.name: EV-Extract-ByTIN
policies.xml:
<ExtractVariables name="EV-Extract-ByTIN">
    <DisplayName>Extract Request - ByTIN</DisplayName>
    <Source>request</Source>
    <JSONPayload>
        <Variable name="req.tin" type="string">
            <JSONPath>$.tin</JSONPath>
        </Variable>
    </JSONPayload>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</ExtractVariables>

policies.name: RF-InvalidCertificateType
policies.xml:
<RaiseFault name="RF-InvalidCertificateType">

            <StatusCode>400</StatusCode>
            <ReasonPhrase>Bad Request</ReasonPhrase>
        </Set>
    </FaultResponse>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</RaiseFault>

policies.xml:
<AssignMessage name="AM-BuildRequest-ByNationalID">
    <DisplayName>Build SOAP Request - ByNationalID</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathUrl</Name>
        <Value>ZakatCertificate/3.0/CertificateService.svc</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
    <Set>
        <Headers>
            <Header name="SOAPAction">http://tempuri.org/IDZITService/GetZakatCertificateByNationalityIDOrIqamaID</Header>
            <Header name="Content-Type">text/xml; charset=utf-8</Header>
        </Headers>
        <Payload contentType="text/xml"><![CDATA[<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:tns="http://tempuri.org/">
   <soapenv:Body>
      <tns:GetZakatCertificateByNationalityIDOrIqamaID>
         <tns:IDType>{req.idType}</tns:IDType>
         <tns:ID>{req.idValue}</tns:ID>
      </tns:GetZakatCertificateByNationalityIDOrIqamaID>
   </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>]]></Payload>
    </Set>
    <AssignTo createNew="false" transport="http" type="request"/>
</AssignMessage>

    <Source>response</Source>

resource.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- XSL-StripNamespaces.xsl -->
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
<xsl:output method="xml" indent="no" omit-xml-declaration="yes"/>

<!-- Strip prefix/namespace off every element -->
<xsl:template match="*">
    <xsl:element name="{local-name()}">
        <xsl:apply-templates select="@*|node()"/>
    </xsl:element>
</xsl:template>

<!-- Copy attributes without their namespace prefix (drop xsi:*, xmlns:* entirely) -->
<xsl:template match="@*">
    <xsl:if test="not(starts-with(name(), 'xmlns')) and not(starts-with(name(), 'xsi:'))">
        <xsl:attribute name="{local-name()}">
            <xsl:value-of select="."/>
        </xsl:attribute>
    </xsl:if>
</xsl:template>

<xsl:template match="comment()|processing-instruction()"/>

<xsl:template match="text()">
    <xsl:copy/>
</xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
